nc079145f67.headline: Rupee Gains 9 Paise To Close At 90.57 Against US Dollar On Equity Strength
nc079145f67.summary: The rupee recovered from early losses to close 9 paise higher at 90.57 against the US dollar, helped by strong domestic equities and a softer dollar. Geopolitical tensions and importer demand limited gains.
nc079145f67.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, foreign investment flows and inflation for India's economy.

na63f9d4fbd.headline: 'Is 0 bigger than 18?' Akhilesh Yadav questions India-US deal; says Budget ignores PDA, farmers
na63f9d4fbd.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav criticised the recently announced interim trade agreement between India and the US. He questioned whether the Union Budget was prepared before or after the deal was finalised.
na63f9d4fbd.why: Trade agreements between India and the US shape tariff access and supply-chain flows for Indian exporters and importers.

n98d5df3740.headline: LAZARD REPORTS JANUARY 2026 ASSETS UNDER MANAGEMENT
n98d5df3740.summary: Lazard reported preliminary assets under management as of January 31, 2026, totalling approximately the amount stated in its release. The figures are preliminary.
n98d5df3740.why: Lazard is an investment bank and asset manager, and its assets under management reflect fee-earning investment capacity.

n960fc1e9ba.headline: EU must cut power prices to be competitive, central European leaders say
n960fc1e9ba.summary: The prime ministers of Austria, the Czech Republic and Slovakia said the EU must act to cut electricity prices to safeguard industrial competitiveness. They spoke ahead of a meeting.
n960fc1e9ba.why: Electricity costs are a major input for energy-intensive industry in Europe, so EU energy policy affects manufacturing competitiveness and utility sector economics.

na5aa7e6596.headline: Tax or levy? Government under pressure over gas plan as Labour says Kiwis will feel sting
na5aa7e6596.summary: The New Zealand government has announced construction of a liquefied natural gas import facility. Labour says New Zealanders will feel the cost through a tax or levy.
na5aa7e6596.why: LNG import facilities affect domestic gas supply and energy prices in economies with declining local output. The funding mechanism determines who bears the cost.

n6186c3dd51.headline: Greens demand Treasurer Chalmers hits super with bigger taxes
n6186c3dd51.summary: The Greens are demanding that Treasurer Chalmers apply bigger taxes to superannuation. The report says the party is pressing for a more intense tax regime on super.
n6186c3dd51.why: Superannuation is Australia's mandatory retirement savings system and a major pool of investment capital. Tax changes to super affect fund flows and retirement returns.

n10dd682aea.headline: RBI working with Centre to boost cooperative banks' financial health, digital inclusion: Minister
n10dd682aea.summary: The government and the Reserve Bank of India have taken measures to strengthen cooperative banks' financial health, governance and digital inclusion, a minister said.
n10dd682aea.why: Cooperative banks are small community lenders that serve a large share of Indian households and small businesses. The RBI regulates their operations and capital adequacy.

nc3daa49ada.headline: What tightening sheep supply means for producers this season: Episode 3
nc3daa49ada.summary: Price indicators for mutton and lamb are beginning to firm as sheep supply tightens, with the trend expected to shape producer conditions this season.
nc3daa49ada.why: Australia is a major global exporter of sheep meat, so domestic supply and price trends affect producers and export markets.

n9c13a4d794.headline: Hydro Reservoir Levels Up 30% Since September
n9c13a4d794.summary: Reservoir fill rates at Greece's hydroelectric plants rose sharply this winter, boosting generation and helping lower wholesale electricity prices, according to the report.
n9c13a4d794.why: Hydropower output is a major source of Greek electricity, so reservoir levels feed directly into wholesale power prices that affect utilities and energy-intensive industry.

n3cfe6f35f4.headline: U.S. stocks hover near records as yields fall after a discouraging report on U.S shoppers
n3cfe6f35f4.summary: U.S. stocks drifted to a mixed finish after flirting with record highs. Yields fell after a discouraging report on U.S. shoppers.
n3cfe6f35f4.why: US equity indexes such as the S&P 500 track large American companies, and Treasury yields influence borrowing costs and equity valuations across markets.
n3cfe6f35f4.why_moved: Yields fell after a discouraging U.S. consumer report, while stocks drifted near record highs without a clear direction.

n9c66a37218.headline: Mib Pulls Back from Highs; Ferrari Rallies After Earnings
n9c66a37218.summary: The FTSE MIB slipped just below parity to around 46,800 points, a modest profit-taking move after fresh all-time highs the previous session. Ferrari rallied after its earnings.
n9c66a37218.why: The FTSE MIB is Italy's main blue-chip index, and Ferrari is a luxury carmaker whose shares are a large part of the market's trading interest.

ne9310e94a4.headline: Syria, Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank discuss reconstruction financing in Jeddah
ne9310e94a4.summary: Syrian Finance Minister Mohammed Yisr Barnieh held talks with an Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank delegation in Jeddah on February 10. The discussions focused on reconstruction financing.
ne9310e94a4.why: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank is a multilateral lender that finances infrastructure projects, and its funding decisions shape reconstruction and development spending.

ne5fe41e681.headline: South Korea to start reviewing US investment projects ahead of enacting bill
ne5fe41e681.summary: South Korea will begin reviewing US investment projects ahead of enacting a bill. The step follows Trump's threat of auto tariffs over the delayed $350 billion investment bill.
ne5fe41e681.why: South Korea is a major exporter of cars and electronics to the US, so tariff threats and investment commitments directly affect its trade-exposed companies.
ne5fe41e681.why_moved: Trump's threat of auto tariffs over the delayed $350 billion investment bill raises trade tensions that Seoul is trying to ease.

n6349660d37.headline: More banks give $15b PNG gas project the cold shoulder
n6349660d37.summary: A total of 27 banks and credit agencies have committed not to finance a proposed TotalEnergies-Santos gas project in Papua New Guinea. The project is valued at about $15 billion.
n6349660d37.why: TotalEnergies and Santos are major LNG producers, and project financing from banks determines whether large gas developments can proceed.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies
impacts.why: As a project partner, TotalEnergies faces the same financing constraints on the proposed gas project.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n0e6bf1aa41.headline: Sensex, Nifty post moderate gains amid strong domestic earnings cues
n0e6bf1aa41.summary: Indian equity indices posted moderate gains on Tuesday, rising for a third consecutive session. Strong Q3 earnings from select companies supported the market.
n0e6bf1aa41.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies across the economy.

n5f8cbd52ca.headline: Australia's Treasury Wine settles dispute with US distributor, shares jump
n5f8cbd52ca.summary: Treasury Wine Estates said it had settled a dispute with US distributor Republic National Distributing Company over the closure of its California operations. Shares jumped after the announcement.
n5f8cbd52ca.why: Treasury Wine Estates is an Australian wine producer whose US business relies on distribution partners, so disputes affect its sales and earnings.

nd7d3ce4477.headline: Signs point to RBA fine tuning, rather than hike spree
nd7d3ce4477.summary: Softer labour market data and consumer confidence suggest the Australian economy is returning toward balance, pointing to fine-tuning rather than a series of rate hikes.
nd7d3ce4477.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs and the Australian dollar. Labour and confidence data feed into its rate decisions.

n8ed3618b38.headline: India's GDP likely to grow 6.9 pc in 2026, US trade deal to add 20 bps: Report
n8ed3618b38.summary: India's real GDP growth is likely to reach 6.9% in 2026 and 6.8% in 2027, and the recent US-India trade deal should add about 0.2 percentage points, a report says.
n8ed3618b38.why: GDP growth forecasts shape investor views on Indian equities, bonds and the rupee. Trade agreements can affect export demand and growth.

n214926cbe9.headline: Kroger’s New CEO Greg Foran Aims to Revitalize Troubled Supermarket Chain
n214926cbe9.summary: Kroger has appointed Greg Foran as CEO, nearly a year after Rodney McMullen resigned over an undisclosed ethics violation. Foran previously held top positions at Walmart U.S.
n214926cbe9.why: Kroger is one of the largest US supermarket operators, and leadership changes often signal shifts in strategy and profitability for grocery retailers.

n3a6186a94e.headline: Malaysia’s Khazanah Nasional fund reports higher profit, 5.2% investment return in 2025
n3a6186a94e.summary: Malaysia's sovereign wealth fund Khazanah Nasional reported higher profit and a 5.2% investment return for 2025. It is a major shareholder in some of the country's biggest companies.
n3a6186a94e.why: Khazanah is Malaysia's sovereign wealth fund and holds stakes in major domestic companies, so its returns reflect state-linked investment performance.

n2d509ac6ce.headline: Passage of defense budget ‘cannot wait,’ president tells nation - Taipei Times
n2d509ac6ce.summary: President William Lai urged the legislature to pass a proposed NT$1.25 trillion (US$39.74 billion) special defense budget. The Executive Yuan approved the budget on Nov. 27.
n2d509ac6ce.why: Taiwan's defense spending decisions affect government fiscal policy and regional security risk that investors weigh for Taiwan-based assets.

nca7e0030e7.headline: DBS capital return plans remain bright spot even with weaker earnings ahead: analysts
nca7e0030e7.summary: Analysts say DBS's capital return plans remain a bright spot even as the lender expects weaker earnings. For 2026, DBS sees total income around 2025 levels and net profit slightly below 2025.
nca7e0030e7.why: DBS is Southeast Asia's largest bank by assets and a bellwether for Singapore's financial sector. Its dividends and buybacks matter to income-focused investors.

n76134f13c8.headline: Stamford Land sues UOB over allocation of excess rights shares in its 2021 issue
n76134f13c8.summary: SGX mainboard-listed Stamford Land is suing UOB over the allocation of excess rights shares in its 2021 rights issue. The property company claims losses and damages of S$1.88 million.
n76134f13c8.why: UOB is one of Singapore's three big local banks, and it also acts for companies in rights issues. Disputes over share allocation can affect shareholder returns and the bank's legal exposure.

n5237269eb6.headline: Bank Indonesia says there is room to cut interest rate further
n5237269eb6.summary: Bank Indonesia has room to resume its rate-cutting cycle to support growth, but decisions will depend on data, senior deputy governor Destry Damayanti said.
n5237269eb6.why: Bank Indonesia sets the benchmark rate for Indonesia, which influences local bond yields, the rupiah and bank lending.

n6da2550f22.headline: GULF secures THB 60 billion, or approximately USD 1.9 billion, to invest in renewable energy power projects with a total contracted generation capacity of 939 MW
n6da2550f22.summary: GULF has secured THB 60 billion, about USD 1.9 billion, to invest in renewable energy power projects with 939 MW of contracted generation capacity.
n6da2550f22.why: GULF Energy is a Thai power producer and developer, so its funding for renewable capacity signals expansion in Thailand's clean power sector.

n6e6fe450b0.headline: Indonesia's fiscal re-allocation under President Prabowo delivers $30 billion impact without higher borrowing
n6e6fe450b0.summary: Under President Prabowo, Indonesia's 2025 fiscal restructuring focused on spending rationalisation and revenue recovery. It delivered an estimated $30 billion fiscal impact while keeping the deficit within the 3% ceiling.
n6e6fe450b0.why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and its fiscal discipline and deficit rules influence sovereign bond and rupiah assessments.

n5c575c05c7.headline: Cooking Oil Prices Increase Across Pakistan
n5c575c05c7.summary: Cooking oil prices have risen sharply across Pakistan. The increase adds to pressure on households already struggling with rising living costs.
n5c575c05c7.why: Edible oil is a staple whose prices feed into inflation readings that central banks and investors track closely.

n4784d0868b.headline: Taiwan, take note of Takaichi win - Taipei Times
n4784d0868b.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's party won its largest parliamentary majority since World War II. She pledged to tackle economic issues and strengthen national security and defence policy.
n4784d0868b.why: Political stability and fiscal policy direction in Japan affect the yen, Japanese government bonds and the Nikkei index.

n629e5e6e74.headline: Power Minister Explains Why Solar Benefits Have Been Reduced in Pakistan
n629e5e6e74.summary: Power Minister Awais Leghari defended recent changes to solar net metering regulations in the Senate. He said the adjustments were necessary to address the changes.
n629e5e6e74.why: Net metering rules determine the returns for rooftop solar owners and the economics of solar investment in Pakistan.

n4104efe1b0.headline: Bank of America lifts growth forecast for Taiwan to 8% - Taipei Times
n4104efe1b0.summary: Bank of America nearly doubled its 2026 growth forecast for Taiwan to 8% from 4.5%. The upgrade cited relentless global demand after a strong year driven by artificial intelligence.
n4104efe1b0.why: Taiwan is a key semiconductor manufacturing hub, so its growth outlook is closely tied to global AI chip demand.

n4f0af09c38.headline: KT posts earnings surge on property gains, AI-cloud push
n4f0af09c38.summary: KT sharply expanded earnings last year, with solid top-line growth driven by AI-cloud businesses and one-off gains. The results were reported by The Korea Times.
n4f0af09c38.why: KT is one of South Korea's largest telecom operators, and its results indicate how mobile and cloud businesses are performing in the domestic market.

ndba72e7235.headline: Malaysia, Singapore state investors dismiss Indonesia stock selloff, cite their long-term commitment
ndba72e7235.summary: State investors from Malaysia and Singapore said they are committed to investing in Indonesia for the long term, dismissing a stock selloff that followed an action by index provider MSCI.
ndba72e7235.why: MSCI is a major index provider whose benchmarks are tracked by many global funds, so its decisions on a country can trigger passive buying or selling in its stocks.
ndba72e7235.why_moved: The input describes a stock selloff in Indonesia following an MSCI action. Index provider decisions can prompt funds that track MSCI benchmarks to sell holdings.

ne4ac6d3cb6.headline: Hung Tai affiliates acquire 15.1% stake in Taipei 101 - Taipei Times
ne4ac6d3cb6.summary: Affiliates of Hung Tai have acquired a 15.1% stake in the Taipei 101 skyscraper, according to Taipei Times.
ne4ac6d3cb6.why: Taipei 101 is a landmark office and retail tower in Taipei, and stake purchases in such property assets reflect investor interest in Taiwan real estate.

n43e669438f.headline: Luanda Accord Expands as Namibia Signs; GJEPC and DMCC Advance Toward NDC Membership
n43e669438f.summary: At the African Mining Indaba 2026 in Cape Town, Namibia joined the Luanda Accord, while the Gem & Jewellery Export Promotion Council and Dubai Multi Commodities Centre formalized steps toward Natural Diamond Council membership.
n43e669438f.why: The Luanda Accord and Natural Diamond Council membership promote coordinated marketing and regulation of natural diamonds, impacting the diamond trade in Africa and globally.

n24d41fe6bf.headline: Liberia: Waifem Reports Strong Gender, Regional Inclusion in Training Programs
n24d41fe6bf.summary: The West African Institute for Financial and Economic Management highlighted significant impact in regional capacity building and inclusion during its 53rd Technical Committee meeting in Liberia.
n24d41fe6bf.why: Capacity building in financial management supports economic development and governance in West Africa.

n23498f32dd.headline: Pound Falls Amid U.K. Political Uncertainty, BoE Rate Cut Speculations
n23498f32dd.summary: The British pound declined against major currencies due to political unrest in the UK and growing expectations of a Bank of England interest rate cut.
n23498f32dd.why: Currency fluctuations impact trade, inflation, and investment flows; UK political and monetary policy uncertainty affects market confidence.
n23498f32dd.why_moved: Political unrest and speculation about Bank of England rate cuts caused investors to sell the pound, weakening its value.

n480c405091.headline: ArcelorMittal S.A.: ArcelorMittal confirms the construction of an electric arc furnace in Dunkirk, France: a €1.3 billion investment supporting an important step in its decarbonisation
n480c405091.summary: ArcelorMittal announced a €1.3 billion investment to build an electric arc furnace at its Dunkirk steel site, marking a key step in its decarbonisation strategy.
n480c405091.why: ArcelorMittal is a leading global steel producer; investments in electric arc furnaces support industry decarbonisation and may influence steel production costs and environmental regulations.
